hero.subtitle: Handcrafted furniture in wood and forged iron, made in Egypt since 2008.

story.paragraph1: ROYAL IRON is an Egyptian furniture workshop, founded in 2008 with a simple idea: furniture should be solid enough to outlast the home it is made for.
story.paragraph2: Bedrooms, dining sets, tables, consoles, shelving, desks, mirrors and kitchen units — oak and walnut surfaces on black forged frames, sometimes with marble, glass or cane. We also build gates, railings and window grilles to order.
story.paragraph3: After around 15 years at the bench and the forge, we still believe the best furniture is the kind you never need to replace.
